readers.documentTitle: What readers can see in {{title}}: Story Atlas
readers.heading: What readers can see
readers.intro: Everything in your plan is private until you turn an area on. An area you turn on shows with your story once it’s published, for every reader the story’s rating allows.
readers.introItems: To hold one thing back, tick “Keep private” on its own page: a character, a relationship, a section or entry of the story world, or an event. A character, entry or event can also wait until a reader reaches a chapter, so sharing it doesn’t spoil the story.
